Heathbridge Capital Management Ltd bought 12,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.26% with the market. The institutional investor held 618,050 shares of the publishing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $26.94M, up from 605,850 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Heathbridge Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Thomson Reuters Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $27.44B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.74% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $38.78. About 934,540 shares traded or 4.21% up from the average. Thomson Reuters Corporation (NYSE:TRI) has declined 11.55% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.10% the S&P500.
